violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Condensation buildup in kitchen refrigerator dripping onto apples. Possibly from poor seal due to damaged gasket. Protect food items from potential contamination.
Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not accurate or not easily readable. Replace damaged thermometer in kitchen refrigerator.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Particle board shelving in kitchen area showing wear/degeneration. Exposed bare wood surfaces should be resealed. Kitchen refrigerator has badly torn gasket.

Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. Test strips not available at time of inspection. Use test strips on a regular basis to ensure proper chemical sanitation levels are maintained.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Both hand sinks used for food service in facility had items being stored in them. Laundry soaking in hand sink in BOH kitchen. Coffee pots being stored in FOH hand sink.--Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. Keep hand sinks clear of items to encourage proper hand washing.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Stock hand sinks with paper towels to encourage proper hand washing.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor/walls in kitchen area have food splatter/debris build up and need cleaning.

Food service manager certification. — --Person in charge did not hold an approved food service manager certificate. Current site managers/employees d0 not hold a Serve Safe Managers Certificate. Handlers course certificate only.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Working container holding food item was not labeled properly to identify contents. - Several containers in back room refrigerator not labeled or dated. - Ziplock bag with a food item was not labeled or dated in mini fridge in breakfast room.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. - Refrigerator on the breakfast bar used for dairy items such as milk, butter, and yogurt had an ambient temp of 46*F. Since the refrigerator is opened and closed a lot by guests during breakfast, should dial the temperature down to keep below 41*F.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. - Cabinet below coffee machine in need of repair. Evident water damage.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Juice machine in need of cleaning. Buildup accumulating around nozzles.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Cabinets and drawers in breakfast area in need of cleaning. Several drawers had spilled coffee grounds and other items that should be thrown away.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Walls in breakfast service room in need of cleaning. Splash buildup near sink.
Available, adequate capacity, able to maintain proper temperature (4 pts deducted)
Date marking accomplished, discarded (2 pts deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
Clean, employee dressing area, cleaning equipment storage, living/sleeping quarters separate (1 pt deducted)
Approved, safe, unadulterated, approved additives, proper receiving temperature (4 pts deducted)
